PrfHomeContacts.summary: A user control for displaying and editing home contact information for staff profiles, with validation, masking, and state control, and integration with user session and JavaScript.
PrfHomeContacts.purpose: To show and edit staff home contacts in a user interface, manage editable states, perform data binding, validate phone numbers, and respond to user and session state changes.

workflows.name: EditStaffHomeContacts
steps: User initiates edit via cmdEdit_Click.
System switches view to edit mode using Grid.SwitchToEditMode.
System displays details modal popup (mdlDetails).
Data for the selected staff is loaded and bound to the form view.
In PreRender, controls/buttons are set visible/non-visible depending on ScreenIsEditable property and session state.
On update, the staff record is saved, user session is cached, and the user is redirected to the current page.

business_rules: Edit button is only visible if ScreenIsEditable is true.
If UserSession is null, data source select is cancelled.
Phone validation and masking is managed based on UserSession.UsePhoneMask flag.
Country code is defaulted from UserSession.CountryCode if blank.
validations: Phone number fields may use mask validation if enabled.
ValidationSummary3 control collects errors for visual display.
FormView requires correct data binding for updates.
If data source select is attempted with null session, operation is cancelled.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable determines which controls are enabled.
UsePhoneMask determines use/removal of input masks.
system_behavior: Disables edit fields if not editable.
Phone number and fax fields may have masks removed if phone masking is disabled.
JavaScript variables and behaviors are set up with each page interaction.
Updated home contact info is written and user redirected on successful save.
User session is refreshed in cache upon update.
dependencies: Grid utility functions for UI mode switching and display management.
UserSession for contextual user data and permissions.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, operations cancel.
If user or screen is not editable, editing controls are suppressed and fields are read-only.

SiteDocument.summary: A data-layer class representing a document associated with a site.
SiteDocument.purpose: To model and possibly manage the linkage between documents and a given site within the data layer.
content_gaps: No information on workflow, business logic, or behavior. Only data members are defined.

WelcomeStaffAdmin.summary: A page for staff administrators, showing welcome information and employment application management with filters and validation.
WelcomeStaffAdmin.purpose: To greet staff admins, enable filtering and browsing of employment applications, and provide summary information and validation feedback for staff users.

workflows.name: ViewAndFilterEmploymentApplications
steps: Page loads and user session is set up.
Site and discipline dropdowns are populated according to agency.
Date fields default to last 3 months.
User selects site, discipline, date range, or withdrawn filter.
User clicks Refresh to update data.
Grid of applications is loaded with email/status/withdrawn information.
Error or warning panels shown as needed.

business_rules: Date range is required and validated via server-side and client-side validators.
End date must not be before start date.
Withdrawn applications may be included/excluded via checkbox.
Session data is used to control which data is visible and to whom.
conditions: pnlLastLogin only shown if a last-login exists for user.
pnlError and pnlWarning only shown when errors/warnings exist.
system_behavior: JavaScript and AJAX used for dynamic updates.
All filters are server-side; grid is rebound on every filter change.
exceptions: If session is missing, server actions may be cancelled.
Errors and warnings surfaced in panels.

ServiceCode.summary: A data entity for service codes, typically used in lookup lists and associated with courses or timetables, supporting multi-language.
ServiceCode.purpose: To represent service codes and their associated data, support multi-language display, and provide lookup logic for use in other operations (course/timetable assignments).

workflows.name: ServiceCodeLookup
steps: User or system calls static list (e.g. ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID).
Database stored procedure is executed with relevant parameters.
ServiceCode entries are created from result set, localized as needed.
Result list is returned.

business_rules: If alternate language mode is enabled in session, display Name/Notes in alternate language fields.
conditions: Session language flag (UseAltLanguageFields) determines which name/notes are used.
system_behavior: Provides lookup lists from database, localizes entries per session language settings.
Supports code lookup by course or timetable.

SiteProfileHistory.summary: A data and UI class for tracking and presenting the history of profile actions on a site, including audit details.
SiteProfileHistory.purpose: To store, retrieve, and display the history of changes to a site's profile, including which user performed the action, at what time, and what was changed.

workflows.name: SiteProfileHistorySearch
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID, SessionAgencyID, and session.
Stored procedure returns rows for each historical action.
Fields are mapped, localized if necessary, and formatted.
Returned as a list for display in the UI.

business_rules: Tooltip and display info include Agency, Names, and Phone, and format differently for system admins.
calculations: ActionDateFormatted: Short date string of ActionDate.
AgencyUserFormatted: String based on agency, user initials, admin status.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields session flag determines which text fields are used.
system_behavior: Maps SQL data reader fields to business objects.
Panel and UI history updated per selection.
